text.jp: あと、それよりも問題なのが……。
text.official_en: Although I would say that such things will be the least of your concerns if you choose to take this approach.
text.real_en: But there's a bigger problem...

text.jp: あなたに頼みたいことがありまして。
text.official_en: Greetings. I have a favor to ask of you.
text.real_en: I have a favor to ask you.

text.official_en: Er...

text.jp: この世のものとは思えないほどに不味いそうです。
text.official_en: I have heard both its taste and texture described in terms I would rather not repeat here...
text.real_en: Apparently, it tastes so awful it's hard to believe it's from this world.

text.jp: さらに問題なのは、味が……。
text.official_en: To add, the taste of what he peddles is as atrocious as their asking price.
text.real_en: There's another problem, though. The taste...

text.jp: じゃ、どうすればいいんだ？
text.official_en: What part of the cave is that?
text.real_en: Then what should we do?

text.jp:
せっかく療養にきていたのに
水の穢れが起きたことで、
また具合が悪くなってしまって……。
text.official_en: She had been recuperating in Olderion, but the pollution of the waters has caused her condition to worsen once more.

text.jp:
その商人が体にいい食材を売っています。
ただ、値段が高いらしいです。
text.official_en: He peddles food that vitalizes the heart and the soul. However, I am told he charges a small fortune for them.
text.real_en: That merchant sells food that's good for your health. But I hear it's expensive.

text.jp:
その魔物は相当手強いということです。
「滋養肝」を手に入れようとして、無事に帰った者はいないとか。
text.official_en: The monster in question is exceedingly formidable. From what I have heard, no one has come back safely with any viscus vitae in quite some time.
text.real_en: That monster is extremely tough. Apparently, no one who tried to get its Nourishing Liver has returned safely.

text.jp:
それなら大丈夫さ。
俺たちだって相当強いからな。
text.official_en: Shouldn’t be an issue for us. We can hold our own against any fiends.
text.real_en: We'll be fine. We're pretty strong ourselves.

text.jp:
ただ、それぞれ難度が違いますので、
どの方法を選ぶかはよく考えてください。
text.official_en: The amount of effort required will differ. And so, I’d advise that you choose carefully before embarking on any of them.
text.real_en: But they vary in difficulty, so think carefully before deciding which one to try.

text.jp: ただ、どこで汲んでもいいというわけではありません。
text.official_en: Not just any water from the cave will do, however: it must be drawn from a specific part of the cave.

text.jp:
では「滋養肝」を手に入れたら、
サーラのところに持っていってあげてください。
text.official_en: I see. Well, if you manage to get your hands on some viscus vitae, do bring it to Sarah.
text.real_en: Then if you get the Nourishing Liver, please take it to Sarah.

text.jp: どの方法を詳しく説明しましょうか。
text.official_en: Which shall I explain in more detail?

text.jp: なるほど……。
text.official_en: I see...

text.jp:
なるほど……。
お金で解決というわけですね。
text.official_en: ...I see. So you wish to resolve the matter by financial means.

text.jp:
なるほど……。
それでしたらいくつか方法があります。
text.official_en:
I see...
Well, I can think of several approaches to address this.

text.jp:
ふむ……。
その方法ですか。
text.official_en: Ah...so you are curious about that approach.

text.jp: へえ、すごいんだな。
text.official_en: Huh...you must really know your stuff.

text.jp: わからないことがあればいつでも聞いてください。
text.official_en: If you would hear about any of the approaches again, simply ask.
text.real_en: If there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask anytime.

text.jp:
イルズ、
頼みというのはサーラのことなんです。
text.official_en: Returning to the matter at hand. Ilias, the favor I ask is regarding Sarah.
text.real_en: Ilias, it's Sarah I need your help with.

text.jp:
サーラの体調をよくする方法はいくつかあります。
何について話しましょうか。
text.official_en: There are several approaches one might take to cure Sarah. Which shall I elaborate on?
text.real_en: There are several ways to help Sarah feel better. What would you like to know?

text.jp:
サーラの体調をよくする点で言えば、
どの方法を選んでも差はありません。
text.official_en: While all the approaches would be equally viable in restoring Sarah’s health...

text.jp: ニコル、この人が知り合いの薬師か？
text.official_en: Is he the apothecary you were talking about, Nichol?

text.jp: ニコルさん、どうしました？
text.official_en: Nichol. To what do I owe the pleasure?
text.real_en: Nichol-san, what can I do for you?

text.jp: 世界中を？
text.official_en: “Travel the world”...? You personally gather the herbs you use?
text.real_en: All around the world?

text.jp:
南西の森に向かってください。
小高くなった場所で１つ目の「活力ダケ」が見つかります。
text.official_en: Venture to the forest to the southwest. There, in an elevated place, you will find the first ingredient: a rushroom.

text.jp:
同じ病気にかかっても、症状の重さが違ったりします。
それに対応するために、
天然の素材を配合した薬にこだわっているのです。
text.official_en: I do. Even the same illness may vary in the degree of its symptoms. By foraging the herbs myself, I can ensure that I incorporate the best ingredients into my medicines.
text.real_en: Even with the same illness, symptoms can vary in severity. That's why I insist on making medicines with blends of natural ingredients.

text.jp: 味が？
text.official_en: It can’t be <text style="italic">that</> bad, can it?
text.real_en: The taste?

text.jp: 商人から買う
text.official_en: About purchasing the cure from a merchant
text.real_en: Buy from a merchant

text.jp: 必要な素材は２つあります。
text.official_en: There are two ingredients I will need for you to gather.

text.jp: 気持ち悪い、か……。
text.official_en: ...Ick. Well, sure.
text.real_en: Gross, huh...

text.jp:
洞窟についたらニコルに聞いてみてください。
水の守り人には相応しい場所がわかるはずです。
text.official_en: When you get to the cave, consult with Nichol. As a Warden, he should be able to direct you further.
text.real_en: When you reach the cave, ask Nichol. As a Warden of Water, he should know the right place.

text.jp:
私は薬師のイルズ。
新たな薬草を探し求めて、
世界中を旅しています。
text.official_en: Indeed, an apothecary I am. Ilias, at your service. I travel the world in search of new medicinal herbs.
text.real_en: I'm Ilias, an apothecary. I travel the world in search of new medicinal herbs.

text.jp:
素材が揃ったら調薬しますので、
私のところに持ってきてください。
text.official_en: Bring the ingredients to me when you have them, and I shall brew the cure.

text.jp: 素材を集めてくる
text.official_en: About collecting ingredients for a cure
text.real_en: Gather ingredients

text.jp: 終わる
text.official_en: Leave the conversation

text.jp:
街を出て南の山間にいる魔物を倒すと、
サーラの体調をよくするもの「滋養肝」が手に入ります。
text.official_en: Hunt down a particular monster that dwells in the mountains to the south and obtain some viscus vitae from it. That should cure Sarah’s affliction.
text.real_en: Defeat a monster in the mountains south of town to obtain its Nourishing Liver. It should help Sarah feel better.

text.jp: 街を出て西にずっと進むと、商人のいる小屋があります。
text.official_en: Far west of the city, you will find a merchant in a small cabin.

text.jp:
食材を手に入れたらサーラのところに
持っていってあげてください。
text.official_en: At any rate, if you manage to procure the remedy we need, please take it to Sarah.
text.real_en: Once you've got the ingredients, please take them to Sarah.

text.jp:
魔物の一部なので
ちょっと見た目が気持ち悪いかもしれませんが。
text.official_en: As the name implies, it is within the internal organs of the monster. It will not be easy on the eyes...or pleasant to the touch.
text.real_en: Since it's part of a monster, it might look a little gross, though.

text.jp: 魔物を倒す
text.official_en: About obtaining a cure from a monster
text.real_en: Defeat a monster

text.jp: １つ目は、魔物を倒して、治癒に必要なアイテムを手に入れる。
text.official_en: One of them would involve obtaining an item with curative properties. Namely, by defeating a dreadful creature.
text.real_en: First, defeat a monster to obtain an item needed to treat her.

text.jp: ２つ目は、オルデリオンの各地で、薬の素材を集めてくる。
text.official_en: Another approach—one that will require more legwork—would be to concoct a special medicine by harvesting ingredients that can be found around the continent of Olderion.
text.real_en: Second, gather medicinal ingredients from various places around Olderion.

text.jp: ２つ目は水の洞窟で水を汲んできてください。
text.official_en: The second ingredient is water from the Cave of Waters.

text.jp: ３つ目は、高額ですが……商人から食材を買う。
text.official_en: The last would require an exorbitant amount of gil, though it remains an option; you could simply buy the necessary remedy from a merchant.
text.real_en: Third, though it'll be expensive... buy food ingredients from a merchant.
